sub_questions: Does a prior crossed/factorial surrogate x optimizer decomposition exist in offline MBO or offline black-box optimization — the exact thing N6 claims is unowned?
Has anything published SINCE the last audit (2026 especially) appeared that kills N6?
Does the Hutter fANOVA near-miss still only NEAR-miss (one-way, SMAC fixed), and has it been extended to a two-way crossed decomposition?
Does the Liang near-miss still only NEAR-miss (crossed but descriptive and online), and has it been extended with a variance decomposition?
Does the Moosbauer near-miss still only NEAR-miss (two-axis but explicitly declines the two-way fANOVA), and has it or a successor since run the declined analysis?
Is N6 CONFIRMED NONE-FOUND or KILLED, and by which exact queries and which paper?
Does SNGP (liu2020sngp) actually support the distance-aware-uncertainty claim the paper cites it for?
Does Fan (fan2024minucb) actually support the UCB-as-local-search reading and the LCB-paralysis framing the paper cites it for?
Does Shahriari (2016) actually own the doctrine the paper scopes against — that the statistical model matters more than the acquisition heuristic?
Does Li/Rudner/Wilson (2024) actually say what the paper cites it for on cross-surrogate comparison and ensemble-count robustness, and is the year right (ICLR 2024, not 2023)?
Does Kim (2026) actually concede the attribution gap in the words the paper quotes, and is the venue/year right (TMLR 2026 vs the kim2025mbosurvey bib key)?
Do Agarwal (2021) and Demsar (2006) actually support the power argument and the never-claim-equivalence framing the paper builds on them?
Does melis2018sota actually establish the premise that audits normally shrink the effect they audit — the load-bearing premise of the paper's headline direction claim?
Does every \citep key in main.tex and supplement.tex resolve in references.bib, and is every cited paper used for a claim its source actually supports?
Does the literature CONTRADICT the claim that the ensemble's sigma is a distance signal rather than an error signal — does anyone show sigma IS an error signal?
Does the literature CONTRADICT the K-sensitivity framing — does anyone show ensemble robustness DOWN to K=2?
Does any prior de-confounding audit report a corrected effect size that GROWS, which would kill the paper's no-precedent direction claim?
Does anyone already report LCB-paralysis-style frozen or optimizer-invariant surrogate cells on Design-Bench?
Is any prior work a KILL against N6 or against any specific row of the claim ledger?

Across EVERY substantive claim in the paper — including uncited assertions, reported effect sizes, and the pre-registration outcomes — does the primary literature contradict, undercut, or already own any of them, independent of whether that claim carries a citation?

Is there a stronger paper here that is entirely UNEXPLORED — a result the data would support that the paper does not attempt at all, distinct from results it explored but under-executed or under-explained?
Which claim does the paper UNDER-state relative to its own evidence — is the budget-axis separation or the two-strengthenings pattern a bigger result than its framing?

Which result is explored but UNDER-EXECUTED — what specific runnable experiment does the literature motivate that would convert the seven eliminations into a positive mechanism, and is it CHEAP or EXPENSIVE?
Which result is explored but UNDER-EXPLAINED — which finding stated flatly would the literature let the paper frame more sharply?
What could not be verified, and why?
